sloka: इति इव वदतः कृच्च्रात् बाण अभिहत मर्मणः ।विघूर्णतो विचेष्टस्य वेपमाचस्य भूतले ॥२-६३-५४॥
transliteration: iti iva vadataḥ kṛccrāt bāṇa abhihata marmaṇaḥ ।vighūrṇato viceṣṭasya vepamācasya bhūtale ॥2-63-54॥

translations.english: "Then, gentle lady, seeing him lying on the Sarayu, lamenting in his distress, his limbs wet with water, gasping unceasingly and wounded to the quick, I was most deeply stricken."
